en.askTitle: Swap in your own destination, dates and passports, and get the same entry checklist from official pages
en.runTitle: Australian couple, 10 days in Bali in April 2027: what to do, in what order, and what it costs

fields.label: Arrival local date, time and airport
Passport nationality, type, expiry and visa or residence status
fields.value: I’m Australian and travelling with my partner

en.template: Plan entry to {destination} for {purpose}, arriving {arrival}, leaving {departure} and transiting {transit}. Each traveller has {travellers}. Check official visa, declaration, levy, health, customs and airline requirements for those dates. Show individual and group costs in {currency}, separating fees from processing/FX estimates; explain entry validity, stay limits and timing. Link official pages with read dates, flag conflicting or inaccessible guidance and uncertain future rules, give offline-document and recheck lists. Do not submit, upload passports, contact anyone, pay or promise entry.

phases.title: Check current official visa, arrival card, tourist levy and airport requirements, and mark what is unconfirmed for 2027
phases.note: Official Indonesian immigration, customs and Bali government pages, plus Australia’s Smartraveller
phases.judgment: It flagged where official sources disagree instead of picking one side: Smartraveller’s summary implies an advance e-VOA is mandatory, while its detailed advice and Immigration still allow a visa on arrival at the airport. It also said April 2027 arrangements are not confirmed.

phases.title: Build a phone-friendly one-page checklist and a linked cost and deadline spreadsheet
Check both files, then summarise the key requirements and caveats

workers: Checked the official All Indonesia arrival card (timing, cost, group submissions, separate customs and health forms) and the Bali tourist levy

zh.askTitle: 换成你自己的目的地、日期和护照，得到同样来自官方页面的入境清单
zh.runTitle: 澳洲夫妇 2027 年 4 月巴厘岛 10 天：要做什么、按什么顺序、花多少钱

fields.label: 当地抵达日期、时间及机场
途经国家
fields.placeholder: 例如：在新加坡转机停留 3 小时

fields.label: 护照国籍、类型、有效期和签证或居留身份
fields.value: 我是澳洲人，和伴侣同行

zh.template: 请帮我准备去{destination}、为{purpose}旅行的入境清单：抵达{arrival}，离开{departure}，途经{transit}；每位旅客的护照国籍、类型、有效期和签证或居留身份是{travellers}。按实际日期核查官方签证、申报、旅游税、健康、海关及航空公司要求。以{currency}列个人和同行总费用，分开政府收费及办理、汇兑估算，说明入境有效期、停留限制和办理时间。附官方链接及查阅日期，标出冲突、无法访问和未来待定规则，给我离线文件及复核清单。不要提交、上传护照、联系、付款或保证入境。

phases.title: 核对官方当前的签证、入境卡、旅游税和机场要求，标出 2027 年尚未确认的部分
phases.note: 印尼移民、海关和巴厘省政府官方页面，加上澳洲 Smartraveller
phases.judgment: 官方说法不一致时它没有只选一边：Smartraveller 摘要暗示必须提前办电子落地签，但其详细建议和印尼移民局仍允许机场办理落地签。它也明确说，2027 年 4 月的安排尚未确认。

phases.title: 做出手机上好用的一页清单，以及带链接的费用与截止日期表格
检查两份文件，然后概述关键要求和注意事项

workers: 核对印尼官方“全印尼”入境卡（办理时间、费用、团体填报、是否另需海关和健康表格）以及巴厘岛旅游税
